title: God Tested Abraham
text: Some time later God tested Abraham …

title: We Will Return
text: The boy and I will go over there to worship, and then we will return to you.

title: God Himself Will Provide
text: God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.

title: A Ram in the Thicket
text: … a ram in a thicket, caught by its horns.

title: The LORD Will Provide
text: And Abraham called that place The LORD Will Provide.

title: Because You Obeyed
text: And through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.

title: The Eternal God
text: … and there he called upon the name of the LORD, the Eternal God.

title: The Well of the Oath
text: So that place was called Beersheba, because it was there that the two of them swore an oath.

title: God Could Raise the Dead
text: Abraham reasoned that God could raise the dead …

title: Mount Moriah
text: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah …

title: He Gave His Own Son
text: He who did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all …
